metadata.title: CodingMon · 50-Creature Asset Pack
metadata.description: 10 vorhandene Shinon Forge CodingMon plus 40 neue Abstammungsformen, Daten, Moves, SVG/PNG-Assets und eine interaktive Katalog-Galerie.

canonicalSource.normalization: normalized during integration from the supplied ArtPack and checked-in data shards; the SHA-256 identifies the original ArtPack JSON, not this normalized file

metadata.expansionNotice: Die zehn vorhandenen Arten-IDs, Basiswerte, Elemente und bestehenden Abstammungsverknüpfungen sind aus dem Repository übernommen. Die 40 Ergänzungen, ihre Werte, Moves und Illustrationen sind neu für dieses Paket entworfen.

combatAssumptions.growthCurve: Not defined here; apply the active game contract. These are base values.

metadata.lineageSemantics: lineageDepth is static species ancestry depth, matching the planned rename from LINEAGE.generation to LINEAGE.depth; it is not a creature breeding generation stored in a save.
metadata.artwork: Fresh generated vector artwork; not copies of the repository’s original .grid/.svg sprites.

animationViews.kind: CSS motion plus SVG overlays; static source art preserved
